rationale: Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership LP is the private DBFM project company and concessionaire for the Phase 1 Patient Tower, which is the underlying physical project rather than a second manager-level PortCo. Direct project, manager and current audited hospital evidence supports one canonical record, two active 2016 equity sponsors, and an operating and maintenance obligation continuing to July 2048. No later project-level sponsor sale, equity transfer, signed pending exit or concession termination was identified.

operatingResolution.description: Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership LP is the availability-based design-build-finance-maintain project company for the Etobicoke General Hospital Phase 1 Patient Tower in Toronto, Ontario. The C$330 million project added an approximately 250,000-square-foot, four-storey clinical tower. Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. and DIF Infrastructure IV through DIF Infra 4 Canada Ltd. were the equity sponsors at the May 2016 financial close. Construction reached substantial completion on February 19, 2019. William Osler Health System's audited statements for the year ended March 31, 2026 continue to identify Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership as responsible for operating and maintaining the building, with project assets transferring to Osler in July 2048. Exact sponsor percentages are not publicly disclosed.
operatingResolution.productsAndServices: Project financing, lifecycle renewal and long-term facilities operation and maintenance under an availability-based hospital DBFM agreement.
operatingResolution.customersAndEndMarkets: William Osler Health System and Ontario acute-care infrastructure users.

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: Infrastructure Ontario awarded the C$330 million contract to Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership on May 6, 2016. Axium's direct release names Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. and DIF Infrastructure IV as equity sponsors; the transaction record identifies DIF Infra 4 Canada Ltd. as the DIF vehicle. Exact equity percentages were not disclosed.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentStatus: CLOSED_ACTIVE. Infrastructure Ontario's current project page still names Axium Infrastructure Canada and DIF Infra 4 Canada Ltd. as the developers. Axium's current portfolio lists the operational project, its 2024 PAI statement includes Etobicoke General Hospital among investee assets, and William Osler's March 31, 2026 audited statements continue to identify Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership as responsible for operating and maintaining the building.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: Official project, sponsor, manager, hospital and service-provider pages plus targeted sale, transfer, secondary, refinancing, restructuring, termination and pending-exit searches through 2026-08-18 found no project-level sponsor sale, equity transfer, signed pending exit or concession termination. CVC's 2024 acquisition and rebrand of DIF Capital Partners was a manager-level transaction only.

milestones.event: Infrastructure Ontario and William Osler Health System awarded and financially closed the C$330 million DBFM contract with Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership; Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. and DIF Infrastructure IV were the equity sponsors.
Ontario announced up to C$358 million of provincial investment in the Etobicoke General Hospital expansion.
The Phase 1 Patient Tower reached substantial completion and entered its operating phase.

William Osler Health System's audited statements continued to identify Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership as responsible for operating and maintaining the building, with project assets transferring to Osler in July 2048.
